Name: WON_STATUSES
Notes: Opportunity statuses (entitystatus IDs, comma list) that count as Won. Empty: the script stops.

Name: LOST_STATUSES
Notes: Opportunity statuses (entitystatus IDs, comma list) that count as Lost. Empty: the script stops.

Name: DESIGN_SUBSTATUS
Notes: Opportunity sub-statuses (comma list) that mean In design. Production: 1,4,5,13. Empty: the script stops.

Name: NEEDINFO_SUBSTATUS
Notes: Opportunity sub-statuses (comma list) that mean we need design information from the customer (Awaiting Design Info). Empty: the script stops.

Name: DELIVERY_SUBSTATUS
Notes: Opportunity sub-statuses (comma list) that mean For delivery. Production: 8,11. Empty: the script stops.

Name: EXCLUDED_STATUSES
Notes: Sales order Record Statuses (comma list) never shown or bookable. The same Record Statuses as the sync's custscript_opsync_excluded_statuses. Empty: the script stops.

Name: EXCLUDED_QUOTE_TYPES
Notes: Quote type (customrecord16) IDs, comma list, never shown to customers: Parts and FOC. Empty: the script stops.

Name: PAY_BACS
Notes: The customlist_cust_pay_intent ID for paying by bank transfer. Empty: the script stops.

Name: PAY_CARD
Notes: The customlist_cust_pay_intent ID for paying by card. Empty: the script stops.

Name: FALLBACK_EMPLOYEE
Notes: Employee internal ID used as the email author and Task assignee when the sales rep is missing or inactive. Empty: the script stops.

Name: PREPAY_TERMS
Notes: Terms IDs (comma list) whose customers pay up front. Empty: everyone pays up front.

Name: PAY_ACCOUNT
Notes: The customlist_cust_pay_intent ID for Add to account. Empty: the account option is never offered; everyone pays up front.

Name: RELEASED_STATUSES
Notes: Record Statuses (comma list, e.g. Release to Warehouse) that stay visible although they are in EXCLUDED_STATUSES. Empty: released orders stay hidden.

Name: RECENT_DAYS
Notes: How many days back Recently delivered looks. Empty: 7.

Name: RECENT_HIDDEN_STATUSES
Notes: Record Statuses (comma list) never shown in Recently delivered. Empty: hide none.

Name: QUOTE_TYPE_LABELS
Notes: JSON {"<quote type id>": "UFH", ...}: the short label for each quote type. Empty or invalid: each type's own text. Never fails a page or email.

Name: LOGO_URL
Notes: The logo image's https URL. Empty or not https: no logo.

Name: TIME_VALUES
Notes: customlist_del_time_per IDs offered on the delivery form, in display order (e.g. 2,5,3). Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: VEHICLE_VALUES
Notes: customlist_delivery_veh IDs offered on the delivery form (e.g. 1,2,3,4,5,6; never Nu-Heat to deliver). Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: UNLOAD_VALUES
Notes: customlist_unload_req IDs offered on the delivery form (e.g. 1,2,3). Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: PE_VALUEPROPS
Notes: Value propositions (comma list) whose account manager is the PE rather than the sales rep. Dashboard only. Empty: always the sales rep.

Name: NOTICE_DAYS
Notes: Working days' notice before the earliest delivery date. Empty: 3.

Name: BANK_NAME
Notes: Bank name shown on the bank transfer confirmation. Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: BANK_SORT
Notes: Bank sort code shown on the bank transfer confirmation. Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: BANK_ACCOUNT
Notes: Bank account number shown on the bank transfer confirmation. Dashboard only. Empty: the script stops.

Name: OPTION_HINTS
Notes: JSON {"vehicle": {"<id>": "<hint>"}, "unload": {"<id>": "<hint>"}}: hints under the vehicle and unloading options. Dashboard only. Empty or invalid: titles only. Never fails the page.

Name: EDD_DEFINITE
Notes: The customlist955 ID for Customer Definite, written to EDD certainty on every booking. Dashboard only. Empty: not written.

Name: DIGEST_MODE
Notes: Digest only: TEST (only DIGEST_TEST_CUSTOMERS) or LIVE (every customer due). Empty: the digest stops.

Name: DIGEST_TEST_CUSTOMERS
Notes: Digest only: customer internal IDs (comma list) emailed in TEST mode. Required when the mode is TEST; not read in LIVE.

Name: DIGEST_DAYS
Notes: Digest only: days between one customer's digests. Empty: 14.

Name: DIGEST_CAP
Notes: Digest only: the most customers emailed in one LIVE run; the rest wait for the next run. Empty: 200.

Name: UPD_LOST_STATUS_MAP
Notes: Dashboard only, record only (no parameter). JSON {"CUSTOMER": "<status id>", "PROSPECT": "<status id>", "LEAD": "<status id>"}: the Lost opportunity status for a customer at each stage (Production: {"CUSTOMER": "14", "PROSPECT": "35", "LEAD": "54"}). Each status must also be in LOST_STATUSES. Empty, invalid or no entry for the customer's stage: Not going ahead sends the Task but does not set Lost.

Name: UPD_BUILD_STAGES
Notes: Dashboard only, record only (no parameter). custbody_build_stage option IDs (comma list) offered as What stage is your project at?, in display order. Empty: the stage question is hidden.

Name: UPD_OBJECTION_TYPES
Notes: Dashboard only, record only (no parameter). customrecord_nh_objection_type IDs (comma list) offered as Why not? when the customer is not going ahead, in display order. Empty: no reason list.

Name: TIME_DEFAULT
Notes: Dashboard only, record only (no parameter). The customlist_del_time_per ID (Any time) pre-selected as the delivery form's time of day, and booked when no time is posted. Must be one of TIME_VALUES. Empty: nothing pre-selected and a time must be chosen. Not one of TIME_VALUES: the same, and CDB TIME_DEFAULT_INVALID is logged.

Name: UNLOAD_SURCHARGE
Notes: Dashboard only, record only (no parameter). JSON {"<unload option id>": "<amount text>"}, e.g. {"4": "£45 + VAT"}: the surcharge shown under that unloading option, on the confirmation and in the Task. The rep adds the item line; the dashboard never does. Empty or invalid: no surcharge (invalid logs CDB UNLOAD_SURCHARGE_INVALID). Never fails the page.

Name: LINK_BACKFILL_SCOPE
Notes: Link backfill only, record only (no parameter). Which customers cdb_mr_link_backfill.js checks: OPEN (active customers with an open opportunity or an open sales order, the digest's definition) or ALL (every active customer). Empty or invalid: OPEN.

Name: DESIGNINFO_REGISTRY
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. The File Cabinet path of the design information question registry, e.g. SuiteScripts/NuHeat/Customer Dashboard Content/design-info-registry.csv. Read by the dashboard, the digest (once per run) and the Send design information Suitelet. Empty or unreadable: the Tell us about your property page is unavailable (CDB DESIGNINFO_NO_REGISTRY).

Name: DESIGNINFO_FOLDER
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. The internal ID of the Customer Dashboard Uploads folder (private, not Available Without Login), where customers' plans and drawings are saved. Dashboard only. Empty: uploads are refused with a message on the page; text answers still save.

Name: DESIGNINFO_MAX_FILES
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. How many files a customer can upload per question per save. Dashboard only. Empty: 6.

Name: FC_MAP
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. JSON {"<FC pair id>": "solid|joisted"}: what each custbody_mi_opp_fc value means — floor tokens solid, joisted, overfloor, acoustic joined by |, or one of none (OneZone, Electric UFH, Parts: nothing needed), hp (heat pump only), unknown. Unlisted IDs: unknown. Read by the dashboard, the digest, the opportunity User Event and the Send design information Suitelet. Empty or invalid: the page treats every FC as unknown; the Request design information button and Suitelet refuse.

Name: HEAT_MAP
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. JSON {"<heat source id>": "boiler|nuheat_hp|user_hp|other"}: what each custbody_mi_heat_source value means. Unlisted or empty: other.

Name: VP_MAP
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. JSON {"<value proposition id>": "ufh|ufh_plus|hp"}: the design service of each custbody_value_proposition value (UFH Design, UFH Design +, HP Design). Unlisted or empty: unknown — the customer sees the UFH Design + questions and the Task says so.

Name: NEWBUILD_MARKET_IDS
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. custbody_mis_opp_market IDs (comma list) that mean new build. Empty: every project is treated as existing (retro).

Name: NOTE_TYPE
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. The Note type ID for the design information audit Note. Dashboard only. Empty: the Note is created without a type.

Name: DESIGN_EMAIL_ADDRESS
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. The design team's email (design@nu-heat.co.uk), printed on the Tell us about your property email's contact card when the sender is the Project Engineer. Send design information Suitelet only. Empty: the sender's own email.

Name: DESIGNINFO_EMAIL
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. JSON overrides of the Tell us about your property email's wording, keyed as config.DESIGNINFO_EMAIL (e.g. {"SUBJECT": "…", "PERSONAL_PE": "…"}). Send design information Suitelet only. Empty or invalid: the built-in wording (invalid logs CDB DESIGNINFO_EMAIL_INVALID).

Name: DESIGNINFO_DRAWINGS_URL
Notes: Release 2.3, record only. An https link to the Understanding your drawings page, shown on the design information page. Dashboard only. Empty: the card is left out.
